name: Example Agent
tagline: Email it a question; it emails back an answer it can stand behind.
description:
Send it a question by email and it answers from what you sent, in the same thread.

When it cannot answer — the message carried no question, or the model's reply came back unreadable — it says so plainly instead of guessing. Anything it had to work around is listed with the answer, so you can see what it was unsure of.

capabilities.name: Answers by email
capabilities.description: Replies to the message it is sent, in the same thread.

capabilities.name: Says when it cannot
capabilities.description: Reports an unreadable or missing answer instead of inventing one.
